releases.title: A tighter site, with release notes
notes: Guides, learning paths, the wiki and the blog have been removed, so the site is about Commonveil itself. Their old addresses now lead to the Help Centre.
Release notes for every version, from 0.1.0 onwards, on the site and as tags on GitHub.
The site's version is shown at the bottom of every page.

releases.title: Help Centre
notes: A Help Centre with an article for every feature: what it's for, how to use it and what it shares.
The complete guide on one page, to print or download, and as docs/USER_GUIDE.md on GitHub.
"How this works" links from settings pages to the right article.

releases.title: Scheduled tasks fixed
notes: Scheduled tasks now run reliably: scheduled messages, check-ins and self-destructing conversations every 5 minutes, disappearing messages every 30 minutes, and opt-in account deletion daily.
The self-destruct menu no longer lists "Off" twice.

releases.title: Send later, safety check-ins and self-destructing chats
notes: Send later: write now, deliver from a minute to a year ahead.
Safety check-ins: a message that sends itself unless you tap "I'm OK" in time.
Self-destructing conversations, deleted for everyone at a time you choose.
A privacy report showing everything the service holds about you, with a privacy checkup.
Quiet hours and focus for notifications, kept on your device.

releases.title: Names in moderation
notes: Reports and cases show the names of members who aren't in the member list, instead of "Member".

releases.title: Security audit and built-in moderation
notes: Fixes from a full security review: channel permissions, private channels, call membership checks and safer word matching.
Reports to a server's moderators, encrypted to them alone, and escalation to the Commonveil team.
Numbered cases, warnings with automatic steps, flood and raid protection, staff limits, temporary bans and message purges.

releases.title: Files, voice messages, events and more
notes: Encrypted files and voice messages.
A server's own emoji and stickers, AutoMod, threads and events.
Optional online status and typing, stage channels, and calls in conversations.

releases.title: Video and screen sharing
notes: Turn your camera on or share your screen in calls, with every video frame encrypted too.

releases.title: Polls, inbox and quick switcher
notes: Polls, every emoji as a reaction, an inbox for mentions and unread channels, saved messages, a quick switcher (Ctrl + K), server folders, private notes and forwarding.

releases.title: Calls recover from network drops
notes: Calls find a new route by themselves after a network drop.

releases.title: Calls survive a quick reconnect
notes: You keep your place in a call through a quick reconnect.

releases.title: Encrypted voice calls
notes: Peer-to-peer voice calls in voice channels, with signed connections and every audio frame encrypted with the channel's keys.

releases.title: Server settings fixes
notes: Server settings load correctly after a reload, a note about staff in member lists, and clearer text while waiting for keys.

releases.title: Servers and the community hub
notes: Encrypted servers with channels, roles, invites and Discover, the Commonveil Community server, and post-quantum hybrid keys, now live.

releases.title: Faster server updates
notes: Server changes are checked separately from messages.

releases.title: A new layout
notes: A server rail, channel list, chat, forums, tickets and settings, laid out like Discord.

releases.title: Who hands out keys
notes: Servers choose whether any member's app or only staff hand keys to newcomers.

releases.title: Post-quantum keys and encrypted servers
notes: Keys sealed with ML-KEM-768 and P-256 together, and the groundwork for encrypted servers.

releases.title: Checks after going live
notes: The live site was checked, and the security policy test fixed.

releases.title: Live, with updated privacy pages
notes: The new features were verified on the live site, and the Privacy and Security pages updated.

releases.title: Replies, reactions and a passcode lock
notes: Replies, reactions and edits; disappearing-message timers and group admins; alerts; message search on your device; a passcode lock; a download of your data; opt-in auto-delete; and site search.

releases.title: Timers, admins and security emails
notes: Disappearing messages, group admins, security emails, opt-in deletion of unused accounts and scheduled clean-up, on the server.

releases.title: Protocol version 2
notes: Fixes from a review of the encryption protocol, each member reading with their own access, and a staff tool for erasing what removed sign-ins left behind.

releases.title: Signed group changes
notes: Changes to groups need a device signature, membership can be paused, a stale-keys fix, and a browser test suite.

releases.title: The rebuild
notes: Commonveil rebuilt from scratch: end-to-end encrypted direct messages and groups, device linking, a 24-word recovery phrase and safety numbers.
The public site, with content brought over from the old one.
